title: Maw
html_source:
Hail glorious James, if not Séamus !

The posthumous maw was used by Ted Hughes in Wodwo:152 – ‘octopus maw’ and Séamus Heaney in

Come to the bower

‘Is waiting. Out of the black maw
of the peat.’

A fitting tribute that two friends and poets should use the word of he who defined modernism and invented post-modernism with Finnegans Wake:

http://lit.genius.com/James-joyce-finnegans-wake-chap-11-annotated.
